sources.label: SPHMC proximal phase and coefficient prerequisites
sources.scope: Derived absolute-integral prerequisite for Appendix D1/D2 using the actual B1 coefficients. This does not prove individual Clenshaw-Curtis weight nonnegativity, logarithmic Lambda, complete B1, interpolation remainder B2 or either main theorem.

assumptions: J is a natural number>=2 and h is a positive real. Fin J uses indices i=0,...,J-1 corresponding to source j=i+1.

t_i=h/2[1-cos(i*pi/(J-1))]; ell_j is the real Mathlib Lagrange cardinal polynomial at those nodes; Lambda is the actual supremum of sum_j|ell_j(s)| on the compact interval[0,h]; b_j=integral_0^h ell_j(s) ds using real Lebesgue measure.
units.statement: For these actual source nodes and integral coefficients, sum_j |b_j| <= h*Lambda. The finite compact supremum and every needed interval integrability are derived from polynomial continuity. No b_j>=0 or supplied coefficient envelope is assumed.
units.boundary: Derived absolute-integral prerequisite for Appendix D1/D2 using the actual B1 coefficients. This does not prove individual Clenshaw-Curtis weight nonnegativity, logarithmic Lambda, complete B1, interpolation remainder B2 or either main theorem.

steps.title: Bound the actual compact supremum
steps.text: The basis polynomials are continuous. Thus F(s)=sum|ell_j(s)| is continuous and bounded above on[0,h]. The defining supremum bounds every F(s) on that interval. All basis and absolute-basis functions are interval integrable by continuity.

steps.title: Sum absolute defining integrals
steps.text: Bound each absolute integral by its norm integral. Use derived interval integrability to move the finite sum inside the integral. Integrate F<=Lambda over the positive ordered interval. No source-prose positivity assertion is imported as a premise.
